text.p: Morgan Stockbroking Ltd recommended diversified services group Mayne Nickless Ltd as a buy, reflecting the group's expansion plans, particularly into the health care sector.
"Expansion into health care is likely to be the main focus of the group in the medium term," Morgan analysts said in an investment report.
This expansion was most likely to take place in Australia and Asia, with about A$700 million in assets already and further potential acquisitions in sight, the analysts said.
Mayne Nickless also was confident of an exit from its 24.99 percent of the Optus Communications group with funds to be used to retire debt or for expansion into core businesses, Morgan said.
Morgan analysts forecast a consolidated profit for the current year ending June 30 of A$99.6 million, up from a reported A$84.9 million in 1995/96.
Total dividend for the current year was forecast to be 30 cents a share which would be 50 percent franked compared with a 32 cents total previously which was 65 percent franked.
At the time of the report, Mayne Nickless shares were at A$7.69.
By 0300 GMT (1 p.m.) Thursday, they were at A$7.85, down 10 cents on Wednesday's close.
